authority: Ticket18 editor experience plus Ticket19 J1 exit boundary

runRecordSchema.historyRule: Retest creates a new immutable run record; it never overwrites an earlier result.

cases.title: Keyboard workspace traversal
cases.task: Use only the keyboard to enter and traverse the tree, canvas selection equivalent, property groups, problem summary, preview controls, dialogs, and return paths.
passCriteria: Every interactive target is reachable without pointer input.
Roving focus and focus restoration are predictable and visible.
No keyboard trap occurs.

cases.title: Atomic structure commands and undo
cases.task: Create, duplicate, delete, reparent, and reorder representative Nodes, Definitions, Bindings, Repeat, and TemplateUse, then exercise undo and redo.
passCriteria: Each command updates identity, references, and placement atomically.
Undo and redo remain within one canonical baseline.
Save, overwrite, or restore clears the old undo history.

cases.title: Binding and presence states
cases.task: Create, replace, inspect, and remove Bindings while moving the value through PRESENT, ABSENT, ERROR, type-invalid, and property-invalid states.
passCriteria: Bound, unbound, ABSENT, and ERROR states are distinguishable without color alone.
Type-invalid and property-invalid states remain separately identifiable through accessible text and state.
The UI never implies fallback to the static baseline after Binding failure.
Authoritative validation remains visibly distinct from local feedback.

cases.title: Array reorder target rewrite
cases.task: Reorder an array element referenced by one or more numeric target selectors, including nested and overlapping invalid controls.
passCriteria: The moved semantic item retains its Binding relationship.
All affected numeric selectors rewrite atomically.
An invalid rewrite rejects the whole command without partial state.

cases.title: Problem focus and generation
cases.task: Trigger local, save, closure, and preview problems, then change the draft while navigating summary and detail locations.
passCriteria: The summary receives focus before a detail location is activated.
Stale problem generations cannot move focus in the new draft.
Redacted or unavailable locations remain understandable without fabricated placeholders.

cases.title: Canonical save resynchronization
cases.task: Save content that exercises metadata trimming, set-like ordering, equivalent decimals, and exact Expression source preservation.
passCriteria: The editor replaces its baseline with the server canonical DesignDSL, revision, and contentHash.
A concise normalization summary is available.
Exact Expression source and semantic arrays are not rewritten.

cases.title: Invalid confirmation and truncation guard
cases.task: Exercise a complete dependency-only problem set and then a problem set ending in PROBLEM_LIMIT_REACHED.
passCriteria: Only the complete dependency-only set offers confirmation.
The truncated set cannot be confirmed or saved as INVALID.
Hard, security, version, and capacity failures never offer confirmation.

cases.title: Guarded conflict overwrite
cases.task: Cause an expectedRevision conflict, choose to retain the complete local DesignDSL, fetch the latest current, and submit again; then repeat with another intervening change.
passCriteria: No automatic diff or merge is presented as authoritative.
Overwrite requires an explicit author decision and a fresh expectedRevision.
A second drift requires a new confirmation instead of silent last-write-wins.

cases.title: Unknown save reconciliation
cases.task: Interrupt the save response after the server may or may not have committed, then reconcile against trusted current.
passCriteria: The editor distinguishes converged content, safe explicit retry, conflict, and deletion.
It does not claim command-key idempotency or commit ownership.
It never blindly creates another revision.

cases.title: Recovery, import, repair, and compatibility modes
cases.task: Restore, export, and discard a local recovery draft; import valid and malformed content; enter Raw Repair and Compatibility Read-only and return only through valid transitions.
passCriteria: Recovery is explicit, device-local, and clearly non-authoritative.
Import and migration create only a dirty local draft and perform no server write.
Malformed or unsupported input cannot be partially reserialized by Structured Editor.

cases.title: Authoritative preview freshness
cases.task: Start preview, alter every basis component in turn, cancel, save-and-preview, and deliver late success and failure responses out of order.
passCriteria: Only saved current content can produce Authoritative Preview.
Any basis change withdraws the old image instead of labeling it current.
Generation guards prevent late results from replacing the newest state.
Preview failure never rolls back an already successful save.

cases.title: Screen reader and visual accessibility
cases.task: Complete the core authoring and problem flow with a screen reader, keyboard, 200 percent zoom, reduced motion, and supported high-contrast settings.
passCriteria: Controls expose stable names, roles, values, validation state, and expanded or selected state.
Focus remains visible and content remains operable at 200 percent zoom.
Status announcements are useful and not duplicated or excessively verbose.
Reduced motion and non-color state cues preserve the complete workflow.
Supported high-contrast settings preserve the complete core workflow.
